answer.policy_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Musculoskeletal: CMM-318: Shoulder Arthroplasty/Replacement/Resurfacing/Revision/Arthrodesis
criteria_quotes: Total shoulder arthroplasty (replacement) is considered medically necessary when ALL of the following criteria have been met:

Radiographic imaging and/or advanced diagnostic study (i.e., MRI, CT) correlates with the individual's reported symptoms and physical exam findings and is conclusive for advanced destructive degenerative joint disease (i.e., osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, avascular necrosis) with marked narrowing of the joint space, including ANY of the following: • Irregular joint surfaces • Glenoid sclerosis • Glenoid osteophyte changes • Flattened glenoid • Cystic changes in the humeral head

Symptoms include function-limiting pain (e.g., loss of shoulder function which interferes with the ability to carry out age-appropriate activities of daily living and/or demands of employment) for at least three (3) months
Failure of at least three (3) months of provider-directed non-surgical management

Total shoulder arthroplasty (replacement) is considered not medically necessary for ANY other indication, condition, or when ANY of the following are present: • Active local or systemic infection • Paralytic disorder of the shoulder (e.g., flail shoulder due to irreversible brachial plexus palsy, spinal cord injury, or neuromuscular disease) • One or more uncontrolled or unstable medical conditions that would significantly increase the risk of morbidity (e.g., cardiac, pulmonary, liver, genitourinary, or metabolic disease; hypertension; abnormal serum electrolyte levels) • Charcot joint
answer.submission_route: By mail: Cigna HealthCare National Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 188011, Chattanooga, TN 37422. By fax: Fax numbers are plan-specific and should be checked on the specific denial letter (or by calling Cigna Customer Service). For providers, appeals can also be submitted online via the CignaForHCP.com portal.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: The policy is publicly available. If the patient needs to request any additional internal guidelines, clinical review criteria, or specific records used in making this decision, they can contact Cigna Customer Service at the phone number listed on the back of their member ID card (e.g., 1-800-882-4462 or 1-800-244-6224) or contact Cigna's National Appeals Unit at 704-752-5241.
answer.notes: The CMM-318 policy was updated in late 2025 with an effective date of March 7, 2026. The December 2025 Policy Updates indicate that there were no clinically impactful changes to the criteria from the previous versions. Code 23472 corresponds to total shoulder replacement (glenoid and proximal humeral replacement), which is governed under this policy.
